config_name: Disable Solicited Remote Assistance
command: if (-not (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services' -Name fAllowToGetHelp -Value 0 -Type DWord
note: Help-desk tools that use Windows Remote Assistance stop working

config_name: Disable 'Enumerate administrator accounts on elevation'
command: if (-not (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\CredUI')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\CredUI' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\CredUI' -Name EnumerateAdministrators -Value 0 -Type DWord

config_name: Disable 'Autoplay' for all drives
command: if (-not (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name NoDriveTypeAutoRun -Value 255 -Type DWord

config_name: Set default behavior for 'AutoRun' to 'Enabled: Do not execute any autorun commands'
command: if (-not (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name NoAutorun -Value 1 -Type DWord

config_name: Disable 'Allow Basic authentication' for WinRM Client
command: if (-not (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WinRM\Client')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WinRM\Client' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WinRM\Client' -Name AllowBasic -Value 0 -Type DWord

config_name: Disable 'Allow Basic authentication' for WinRM Service
command: if (-not (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WinRM\Service')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WinRM\Service' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WinRM\Service' -Name AllowBasic -Value 0 -Type DWord

config_name: Disable IP source routing
Set IPv6 source routing to highest protection
Set 'Interactive logon: Machine inactivity limit' to '1-900 seconds'
note: The screen locks after 15 minutes without use

config_name: Enable 'Apply UAC restrictions to local accounts on network logons'
note: Remote admin tools that sign in with a local admin account may stop working

config_name: Enable 'Microsoft network client: Digitally sign communications (always)'
Set user authentication for remote connections by using Network Level Authentication to 'Enabled'
Disable the built-in Administrator account
note: On Azure VMs the account you signed up with IS the built-in Administrator (renamed): create and test another admin account first or you lock yourself out

config_name: Ensure LAPS is enabled on every endpoint and server
note: Done centrally (Intune or Group Policy + Entra ID / Active Directory backup) - not with one command on one PC

config_name: Resume BitLocker protection on all drives
note: BitLocker needs a recovery-key plan first (Intune or Active Directory backup); on Azure VMs use Azure Disk Encryption or encryption at host instead

config_name: Fix unquoted service path for Windows services
note: First look at WHICH services are listed under 'Which PCs'. If they belong to Microsoft Defender (Sense, DefenderUpdateSvc) or another vendor product, do NOT edit them (tamper protection blocks it): the vendor fixes the path in a product update. Only for your own services: put double quotes around the program path (registry ImagePath)

config_name: Set 'Minimum password length' to '14 or more characters'
note: Local accounts only; on company PCs this comes from the domain or Intune password policy

config_name: Set 'Maximum password age' to '60 or fewer days, but not 0'
note: Local accounts only; on company PCs this comes from the domain or Intune password policy

config_name: Set 'Minimum password age' to '1 or more day(s)'
note: Local accounts only; on company PCs this comes from the domain or Intune password policy

config_name: Set 'Enforce password history' to '24 or more password(s)'
note: Local accounts only; on company PCs this comes from the domain or Intune password policy

config_name: Set 'Account lockout threshold' to 1-10 invalid login attempts
note: Accounts lock after 10 wrong passwords: make sure you know how to unlock (or reset) the admin account first

config_name: Set 'Account lockout duration' to 15 minutes or more
note: Only matters once a lockout threshold is set

config_name: Set 'Reset account lockout counter after' to 15 minutes or more
note: Only matters once a lockout threshold is set

Disable Microsoft Defender Firewall notifications when programs are blocked for Private profile

config_name: Disable JavaScript on Adobe Reader DC
command: if (-not (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Adobe\Acrobat Reader\DC\FeatureLockDown')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Adobe\Acrobat Reader\DC\FeatureLockDown' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Adobe\Acrobat Reader\DC\FeatureLockDown' -Name bDisableJavaScript -Value 1 -Type DWord

config_name: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Sharing on your DNS domain network
command: if (-not (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Network Connections')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Network Connections' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Network Connections' -Name NC_ShowSharedAccessUI -Value 0 -Type DWord

config_name: Enable 'Require domain users to elevate when setting a network's location'
command: if (-not (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Network Connections')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Network Connections' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Network Connections' -Name NC_StdDomainUserSetLocation -Value 1 -Type DWord
